svg.text: • maxon DCX 10 L (9 V) + GPX 10 planetary + ENX 10 encoder → KSS SR0401K Ø4 × 1 mm ball screw on a miniature guide

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • → crossed four-bar to the joint (MCP) or through a proximal-phalanx link (PIP), PIP→DIP coupled by a second four-bar (ILDA pattern)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Sensing: motor encoder + TMAG5273 3D-Hall angle sensor at every MCP + Contactile 3-axis force button (Ø10, 0–20 N) under each fingertip

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Overload: ball screw is back-drivable (η ≈ 0.9) so impacts back-drive the motor; spring-detent breakaway in the MCP link; firmware current limit

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Targets: fingertip ≥ 10 N (ILDA reference achieved 28–34 N), power grasp ≥ 50 N, full close ≤ 1 s, payload ≥ 5 kg, hand ≤ 1.0 kg

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Replaceable fingertips: printed PA12-CF distal core with dovetail + cast Dragon Skin 20 cap; palm AnySkin magnetic tactile patch

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Controller: one EtherCAT slave per hand (TI F28P65x + 10× DRV8316 class), placed in the forearm; also drives the 2 wrist linear actuators
